title: 物聯網裝置身分驗證
summary: 以裝置根信任、佈建與憑據更新串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect device roots of trust, provisioning and credential renewal through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 裝置識別：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Device identifiers: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「裝置識別」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For device identifiers, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「裝置識別」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「唯一憑據」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around device identifiers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Serial numbers identify devices but need not authenticate cryptographically. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat unique credentials as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 比較「裝置識別」與「唯一憑據」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Compare whether evidence for device identifiers and unique credentials supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「裝置識別」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for device identifiers. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Serial numbers identify devices but need not authenticate cryptographically.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「唯一憑據」：個別憑據限制單裝置事故的擴散範圍。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「裝置識別」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring unique credentials: Per-device credentials limit the scope of one-device compromise. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove device identifiers passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 100000 裝置各每日驗證一次，平均 1.1574 次/s；若全於 10 min 內集中，為 166.67 次/s，平均流量不足以規劃驗證尖峰。
knowledge.textEn: 100000 devices authenticating once/day average 1.1574/s; concentrating them into 10 minutes gives 166.67/s, so averages do not size authentication peaks.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「物聯網裝置身分驗證」的「裝置識別：架構與原理」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「可信服務：中斷後的交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Device identifiers: architecture and principle” in “IoT device authentication”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Trusted Service: Handoff After an Outage” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 針對「裝置識別」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of device identifiers?
options: 序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。
所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。
只檢查「唯一憑據」，便可取代「裝置識別」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Serial numbers identify devices but need not authenticate cryptographically.
One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free.
Checking unique credentials alone replaces verification specific to device identifiers.
quiz.explanation: 序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。 相鄰的「唯一憑據」有不同責任：個別憑據限制單裝置事故的擴散範圍。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Serial numbers identify devices but need not authenticate cryptographically. Neighboring unique credentials has a different role: Per-device credentials limit the scope of one-device compromise. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 裝置識別：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Device identifiers: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「裝置識別」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For device identifiers, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「唯一憑據」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Serial numbers identify devices but need not authenticate cryptographically. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from unique credentials to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 比較「裝置識別」與「唯一憑據」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Compare whether evidence for device identifiers and unique credentials supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「裝置識別」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for device identifiers. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「根信任」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：根信任界定最早可依據的驗證基礎。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「安全佈建」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around roots of trust, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Roots of trust define initial verifiable foundations. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat secure provisioning as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 比較「根信任」與「安全佈建」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Compare whether evidence for roots of trust and secure provisioning supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「根信任」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for roots of trust. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 根信任界定最早可依據的驗證基礎。
knowledge.textEn: Roots of trust define initial verifiable foundations.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「安全佈建」：初始身分需與實際裝置及所有者關聯。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「根信任」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring secure provisioning: Initial identity must bind the device and owner. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove roots of trust passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「根信任」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of roots of trust?
options: 所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。
只檢查「安全佈建」，便可取代「根信任」的專屬驗證。
根信任界定最早可依據的驗證基礎。
optionsEn: One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free.
Checking secure provisioning alone replaces verification specific to roots of trust.
Roots of trust define initial verifiable foundations.
quiz.explanation: 根信任界定最早可依據的驗證基礎。 相鄰的「安全佈建」有不同責任：初始身分需與實際裝置及所有者關聯。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Roots of trust define initial verifiable foundations. Neighboring secure provisioning has a different role: Initial identity must bind the device and owner. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 根信任：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Roots of trust: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「根信任」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For roots of trust, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「根信任界定最早可依據的驗證基礎。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「安全佈建」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Roots of trust define initial verifiable foundations. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from secure provisioning to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 比較「根信任」與「安全佈建」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Compare whether evidence for roots of trust and secure provisioning supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「根信任」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for roots of trust. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.
